question: The radii of two concentric circles are 35 cm and 21 cm. If the chord of the greater circle is a tangent to the smaller circle, then the length of that chord is:
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ For two **concentric circles**, the length of the **chord** of the larger circle that is **tangent** to the smaller circle is given by: Length of chord = 2 × √(R² − r²) Here, R = 35 cm and r = 21 cm. ⇒ Length = 2 × √(35² − 21²) ⇒ Length = 2 × √((35 + 21) × (35 − 21)) = 2 × √(56 × 14) = 2 × √(784) = 2 × 28 = 56 cm. **∴ The correct answer is 56 cm.**
